title: Aoyagi Toya — Respect For My Teammates〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've finished making a list of all the new books the library received, so I can start practicing some...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Hey, sorry. I already called Akito about this, but it's about Kohane. There's something I want to talk to you guys about.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <I'd like it if the three of us could meet up and talk it over. Are you free now?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That reminds me, she seemed bothered by something that someone said during our last event.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, right. Wanna get some food?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I like your idea about us entering into STAY GOLDEN again so that she'll be able to feel more confident about herself.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right? To be fair, we pretty much went through the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was just wondering what Azusawa's singing will be like once she does find that confidence.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I get what you mean. It's not like she's been letting her nerves get to her while she sings.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Exactly. I genuinely believe she's been giving every performance her all so far.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tono said that there's something interesting about how Azusawa sings.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: All I remember is how he said Kohane was too amateurish and someone he'd never work with...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dude, seriously? You looked pretty pissed then too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that did make me mad too...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, I have no idea what she's gonna be like when she does learn to have confidence in herself...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But even if she does, I doubt her personality will change all that much.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Remember what happened right after we decided to join up as a team? She saw what we were practicing and tried to do everything all in one night.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We did everything we could to stop her and hurriedly came up with a separate list for her to work on.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We managed to come up with something more balanced and probably better for her...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But it was still far too much for any run-of-the-mill novice...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, and it was just meant to be a chance for her to see what she's made of.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She even commented that it was really hard but she still managed to get through all of it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I couldn't believe it either.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Since then, she's kept practicing because she honestly believes there's nothing more fun than singing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And she still seems to believe so even now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If she learns to feel more confident about herself, I'm sure she'll keep falling more in love with singing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And we have to do well at STAY GOLDEN to make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Azusawa keeps saying that she's constantly chasing after us, but that's really just a milestone she's been working towards.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I hope she'll be able to see that there's more beyond that point.
